stories.title: CITU stages nationwide solidarity protests over arrests of Delhi-NCR workers
stories.summary: CITU organised solidarity demonstrations across India after workers were arrested during labour protests in the Delhi-NCR region. Union leader A R Sindhu demanded their release and condemned the police response.
stories.why_it_matters: The mobilisation shows a local labour dispute broadening into a national union campaign over wages, organising rights and the use of police powers against workers.

stories.title: Noida workers say monthly pay of Rs 10,000 cannot cover household costs
stories.summary: Workers interviewed in Noida described trying to support households on wages around Rs 10,000 a month amid a labour dispute that led to protests and violence.
stories.why_it_matters: The testimonies connect industrial unrest to the gap between wages and living costs in a major manufacturing centre, with direct consequences for families and labour relations.
